turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so I'll be brief. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Withdraw it, and tell me why it was entered before anyone spoke to him.
"Get this over with." You asked for this meeting, Hale. Start with why the zero went in before anyone called me.
Look, your son cheated. Everyone knows it. I'm not wasting my evening on this.
My child never lies. "Everyone knows it." Who is everyone, and what do you have on paper? I'm writing that down, Hale.
You lawyers think you can bully anyone.
"Bully." I'm asking who decided, and on what basis. You haven't answered either, Hale.
Are you going to keep wasting my time?
"Wasting your time." Owen's mark is sitting at zero because of a decision you made without calling me. Answer the question: what do you have besides a score?
